verdict.summary: The change correctly closes the untracked-crate gap by comparing every scanned crate against the recorded floors, while preserving the existing checks for disappeared crates, test-count regressions, and lost integration-test directories. The new hermetic decision-table tests exercise the added failure direction, combined failures, and zero-test crates; the live tests independently verify full on-disk coverage and guard against vacuous scans. The targeted 13-test suite passes at the PR head, including the committed full-tree floor invariant. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found in the diff.
